title: connect/1
description: Since 1.5.0. The 200 reply to POST /api/v1/connect: the project the code was made for, and a new key for it. Each connect makes a new key; keys already in use keep working. The key is shown here once: the Portal keeps only its hash. ba-setup writes it into .env and never prints it.

project.description: The Portal project the new key opens.

key.description: The new key: 43 characters of base64url (32 random bytes). It opens the project for publish, fetch and status, like the project's own key.

key_last4.description: The key's last 4 characters, as the Admin sees them under Connected repos.
